payload.rationale: A deliberately broad after-research starting estimate: roughly eight weeks could suffice for localized work with a retained contractor, but recurring defects and uncertain scope prevent high confidence. This is not a pre-research forecast or empirical base rate.
limitations: Repair scope and schedule are not independently verified.
payload.reference_class_exception: Five bounded Exa searches included two searches for prior pool repairs and reopening dates. NPS 2019 routine pipe/cleaning and 2012 structural reconstruction notices were rejected as empirical comparators because scopes differ and realized comparable repair durations are missing. The 2017 cleaning reports supply a promised return date, not verified liner-repair success. The 2026 initial renovation is part of the same dependent episode. Therefore the prior and all scenario weights/conditional completion rates remain judgmental, with wide sensitivity ranges; Flyvbjerg was not given a fabricated cohort.
